title: Dugway chief scientist reveals a huge subterranean facility and its shed entrance
place_text: west of Granite Peak, Dugway Proving Ground, Utah

tellings.quote: who informed this individual MS of the massive stiff or subterranean facility below Dougway

plain: An online commentator who goes by UAPGerb says that the chief scientist at Dugway Proving Ground, a US Army testing range in the Utah desert, told a person known only as MS about a massive underground facility below the base, west of a mountain called Granite Peak. According to the story, its entrance is hidden inside an ordinary-looking shed. If true, it would mean a huge secret installation sits beneath one of America's most restricted military sites.
